claims.assertion: Mari says negative physical experiences may be reinterpreted positively after death, while positive experiences remain positive.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She cautions that interpretation varies by soul.

claims.assertion: Mari rejects entities forcing reincarnation; she attributes return to personal attachments and perceived unfinished aims.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She presents this as her belief.

claims.assertion: Mari says possessions do not cross death; experience and learning do, making spiritual growth more important than accumulation.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She says material objects can still serve individual experience.
